t: A tiny FPGA board the size of a Raspberry Pi Zero, with video out.
steps: Buy the Icepi Zero from Crowd Supply or Elecrow. The list price is about 79 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable and a 1 amp USB power supply.
Check the revision number printed on your board.
Install the OSS CAD Suite with Yosys, nextpnr and openFPGALoader.
Download the Icepi Zero repo and open the programming guide.
Build the blink demo with make and flash it with openFPGALoader.
Add a mini HDMI cable and a monitor for the video demos.
Try the Apple I or Oberon core next.
meta: Wild Open. From $79. A few stores.
